approach: Reuse the existing forecast path and add no new mechanism. build_reading (reading.rs:767-934) turns the reader's forecast into Reading.forecasts.reader plus a reference forecast. The reading is committed before go_job dispatches it (run/mod.rs:456-464), and the gate invariant requires the reading to precede dispatch (athena-gate/src/invariant.rs:10-14). class_forecasts (status.rs:981) scores the forecasts per class. In docs/spec.toml, replace OLY-B-GOAL-03's mechanism "none" (line 2090) with those paths and set the measure (line 2092) to end `status: forecasts`. Add ("forecasts", "forecasts") to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS (status.rs:305). Move the forecasts printing in display.rs into a small helper whose first-row label is the literal "forecasts   ", so every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line (status.rs:1630, which searches the status.rs, display.rs and hestia.rs sources for `"forecasts `) finds it. Add three tests (spec test in status.rs, pre-dispatch forecast test in reading.rs, helper test in display.rs) and a CHANGELOG entry. Scoring, the reference logic and the refusal rules do not change. This revision only completes the criterion 4 demonstration with its seam; the rest of the plan is unchanged.

decisions.choice: Name reading.rs, status.rs, run/mod.rs go_job and the gate invariant as the mechanism, with measure label `forecasts`.
decisions.reason: The reader's forecasts are committed in the reading before dispatch (reading.rs:915; run/mod.rs:456). status.rs:981 already scores them per class and display.rs:1390 already prints them. Naming this path is the smallest honest change; the label needs one table entry.

rejected.option: Build a new forecast role or check.
rejected.why: The path exists. A second one would duplicate it and break the 'small' default.

rejected.option: Write `status: not shown` and name a test.
rejected.why: A status line prints the forecasts, so a label is stronger evidence, and the reading asked for `status: forecasts`.

decisions.choice: Extract the forecasts printing from status() into a helper `forecast_headline_lines(&[ClassHeadline]) -> String`, with the literal "forecasts   " for the first row.
decisions.reason: The label test needs the source to contain `"forecasts ` (status.rs:1640). Today display.rs:1391 has `"forecasts"` followed by a quote, so it does not match. The output stays byte-identical: {label:<11} plus a space is 12 characters, the same as "forecasts   ". A helper is testable without a whole StatusView.

rejected.why: It would loosen a guard for all labels.

rejected.option: Test through status(&StatusView) with a full fixture.
rejected.why: It needs a large StatusView literal; the helper covers the same line with less.

decisions.choice: Put the spec test in status.rs's existing test module, using crate::hestia::parse_spec and measure_problem. The test body must not contain the text `"forecasts ` (a quote, the word, a space), so the label test is not satisfied by the test's own source.
decisions.reason: status.rs is a listed deliverable. The test mirrors hestia.rs:4315 (OLY-B-SET-04 is not a gap). The label test also searches status.rs's own source, so a stray `"forecasts ` there would hide a missing display literal; only display.rs may hold it.

rejected.why: hestia.rs is not a listed deliverable, and the label table lives in status.rs.

decisions.choice: The reading.rs test runs the real build_reading through the existing build_sized/sized_reading helpers (reading.rs:1666-1726) and asserts the committed Reading carries the reader's forecast and a valid reference, and that output without `forecast` is refused.
decisions.reason: Criterion 3 asks for a test that fails when the forecast is removed. build_reading parses ReadingOutput, in which `forecast` is required, so removal errors with 'parsing the reading'.

rejected.option: Only assert a Forecasts field exists.
rejected.why: That checks wiring, not behavior; the behavior-evidence default forbids it.

decisions.choice: Criterion 4 is shown by running the three checks Athena runs over the whole workspace, with named seams: the real docs/spec.toml, the real source files read by include_str!, and the real tests.
decisions.reason: The checks are the acceptance criterion; the interesting guards are the existing tests that read the changed files (label test status.rs:1630, xtask spec test xtask/tests/spec.rs:194, hestia real-spec tests). No fake is used; each reads the file the plan edits.

rejected.option: Run only the new tests for criterion 4.
rejected.why: Criterion 4 says fmt, clippy and the whole test suite pass; the other tests that read the edited spec and sources must be run too.
